environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' level. Container rootfs mounted read-only via securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volumes attached to the pod (volumeMounts section is empty in pod spec). The container runtime uses gVisor (runsc) as the OCI runtime via RuntimeClass 'gvisor', which intercepts and denies filesystem syscalls (open with O_WRONLY/O_RDWR, openat, creat) that target any path since no writable layer exists. Additionally, the pod's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and drops ALL capabilities. Network policy applied to namespace restricts egress to only cluster-internal DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and the backing PostgreSQL CloudSQL instance on port 5432 — all other egress including internet-bound traffic is denied by a Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy with a default-deny egress rule and explicit allowlist.
